What We Offer

Our Services

01
X-Ray Room Installation & Commissioning
We supply, install, and fully commission X-ray machines and radiological equipment in hospital facilities across Nigeria. We handle everything — room shielding, column installation, table setup, control booth wiring, and final calibration testing.
  • Full radiology room design & setup
  • Lead shielding & radiation protection
  • Static, portable & dual-column X-ray systems
  • Control console installation & calibration
  • Wall bucky & cassette system fitting
  • Post-installation testing & sign-off
Completed X-ray room installation · Digha Biomedical
Field repair & maintenance · Digha engineer on-site
02
Equipment Repair & Maintenance
Rapid-response maintenance for biomedical equipment breakdowns. Digha restores hospital operations quickly — reducing costly downtime with reliable, affordable repair solutions. We work on X-ray machines, ultrasound units, and all electronic biomedical systems.
  • Emergency breakdown response
  • X-ray tube & generator repair
  • Control board & circuit diagnosis
  • Ultrasound machine servicing
  • Preventive maintenance contracts
  • Spare parts sourcing & supply
03
Biomedical Equipment Manufacturing
Digha designs and manufactures its own biomedical and electronic equipment in-house — X-ray controllers, hybrid solar systems, phase monitors, automatic transfer switches, and digital/analogue circuit boards. All products are ISO 9001:2000 certified.
  • X-ray control consoles (DMX-650)
  • Ray combiners & switching units
  • Hybrid solar pump controllers
  • Automatic phase transfer switches
  • Digital & analogue PCB design
  • Custom equipment to specification
In-house circuit board manufacturing · Digha Electronics
Ultrasound equipment delivery & demonstration · partner hospital
04
Medical Equipment Supply & Procurement
Digha sources and supplies a wide range of medical imaging and diagnostic equipment for hospitals — including ultrasound machines, gynecological examination chairs, and other clinical hardware — at competitive, hospital-friendly prices.
  • Ultrasound machines (colour Doppler)
  • Gynecological examination chairs
  • Hospital diagnostic equipment
  • Imaging accessories & consumables
  • Equipment demos before purchase
  • After-sales support included
05
Biomedical Engineering Training
Hands-on biomedical engineering training programs run in partnership with state governments, MedShare, and international organizations. 75% practical, 25% theory — focused on real-world equipment handling, ventilator maintenance, and clinical engineering.
  • 75% hands-on practical sessions
  • Ventilator installation & troubleshooting
  • X-ray machine operation & servicing
  • Electronic component identification
  • State government-certified programs
  • Partnered with MedShare & partners
MedShare + Anambra State Biomedical Engineering Training
Hospital delivery & partnership programme
06
Hospital Partnership & ROI Consulting
Digha works as a long-term partner to hospitals — not just a supplier. We help facilities plan their radiology departments, optimize equipment investment, and maximize return on investment while delivering better healthcare outcomes to patients.
  • Radiology department planning
  • Equipment investment advisory
  • ROI optimization for hospital management
  • Long-term maintenance partnerships
  • Government hospital engagement
  • Faith-based & private hospital programs

How It Works

Our Service Process

01
Contact & Assessment
Reach out via phone or email. We assess your hospital's needs — equipment requirements, room dimensions, budget, and timeline.
02
Proposal & Agreement
We provide a detailed proposal covering equipment specs, installation plan, costs, and warranty. Once agreed, we get to work immediately.
03
Delivery & Installation
Equipment is delivered and installed by our certified engineers. Room shielding, cabling, and all ancillary systems are set up professionally.
04
Testing & Handover
Full system testing, staff orientation, and official handover. Ongoing maintenance support begins immediately after commissioning.
